_note: report-brief's checked-in routing corpus — the test of record. Positives are real requests for a CIA-style INTELLIGENCE BRIEFING: rapid expert knowledge transfer with BLUF, confidence-annotated key judgments, competing hypotheses, and intelligence gaps — to make a reader operationally fluent fast. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from the three near-synonymous report-* siblings (the highest-collision family in the marketplace) — a project/sprint STATUS update is report-progress; a comprehensive current-STATE / situation snapshot is report-state; a formal STRATEGY brief with glossary + recommendations is report-strategic — plus resume-author (a CV/resume, not a topic brief). Each negative belongs to a NAMED sibling. routing-eval measures lexical overlap ONLY; the 'brief' token is shared with report-strategic ('strategy brief') so some residual overlap is a proxy limit, not a defect.
